## 1 · Data Overview

### 1.1 Row counts across star schema

```{r tableRowCounts, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}

tables <- c("dim_date","dim_employee","dim_client",
            "dim_project","dim_category","fact_expenses")

counts <- sapply(tables, function(t) {
  dbGetQuery(mysql_con,
    sprintf("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `%s`", t))[[1,1]]
})

count_df <- data.frame(Table = tables, Rows = counts, row.names = NULL)
print(count_df)
```

### 1.2 Fact table partition distribution

```{r partitionCheck, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}

partition_q <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    txn_year          AS year,
    COUNT(*)          AS fact_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(amount_local), 2) AS total_expense
  FROM fact_expenses
  GROUP BY txn_year
  ORDER BY txn_year
")
print(partition_q)
```

## 2 · Expense Analysis by Category

### 2.1 Total and average expense per category (all time)

```{r categoryTotals, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
cat_totals <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    c.category_name                      AS category,
    COUNT(*)                             AS n_transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)        AS total_expense,
    ROUND(AVG(f.amount_local), 2)        AS avg_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_category c ON f.category_key = c.category_key
  GROUP BY c.category_name
  ORDER BY total_expense
")
print(cat_totals)
```

### 2.2 Total expense per category per month

```{r categoryByMonth, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
cat_month <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    d.year                               AS year,
    d.month_name                         AS month,
    d.month                              AS month_num,
    c.category_name                      AS category,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)        AS total_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_date     d ON f.date_key     = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_category c ON f.category_key = c.category_key
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_name, c.category_name
  ORDER BY d.year, d.month, c.category_name
")


print(head(cat_month, 10))
```

### 2.3 Total expense per category per quarter

```{r categoryByQuarter, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
cat_quarter <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    f.txn_year                            AS year,
    CONCAT('Q', f.txn_quarter)            AS quarter,
    c.category_name                       AS category,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_expense,
    ROUND(AVG(f.amount_local), 2)         AS avg_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_category c ON f.category_key = c.category_key
  GROUP BY f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter, c.category_name
  ORDER BY f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter, c.category_name
")
print(cat_quarter)
```

## 3 · Expense Analysis by Client

### 3.1 Total and average expense per client

```{r clientTotals, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
client_totals <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    cl.client_name                        AS client,
    COUNT(*)                              AS n_transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_expense,
    ROUND(AVG(f.amount_local), 2)         AS avg_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_client cl ON f.client_key = cl.client_key
  GROUP BY cl.client_name
  ORDER BY total_expense
")
print(client_totals)
```

### 3.2 Total expense per client per month

```{r clientByMonth, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
client_month <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    d.year                                AS year,
    d.month_name                          AS month,
    cl.client_name                        AS client,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_date   d  ON f.date_key    = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_client cl ON f.client_key  = cl.client_key
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month_name, d.month, cl.client_name
  ORDER BY d.year, d.month, cl.client_name
")
print(head(client_month, 10))
```

## 4 · Expense Analysis by Project

### 4.1 Total expense per project

```{r projectTotals, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
proj_totals <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    p.project_id                          AS project_id,
    p.project_name                        AS project,
    cl.client_name                        AS client,
    p.budget_usd                          AS budget_usd,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_billed,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local) / p.budget_usd * 100, 2) AS pct_of_budget
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_project p  ON f.project_key = p.project_key
  JOIN dim_client cl  ON p.client_key  = cl.client_key
  -- billable filter removed: synthetic data loaded as billable=0
  GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name, cl.client_name, p.budget_usd
  ORDER BY total_billed
")
print(proj_totals)
```

### 4.2 Total expense per project per quarter

```{r projectByQuarter, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
proj_quarter <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    f.txn_year                            AS year,
    CONCAT('Q', f.txn_quarter)            AS quarter,
    p.project_name                        AS project,
    cl.client_name                        AS client,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_project p  ON f.project_key = p.project_key
  JOIN dim_client cl  ON p.client_key  = cl.client_key
  -- billable filter removed: synthetic data loaded as billable=0
  GROUP BY f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter, p.project_name, cl.client_name
  ORDER BY f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter, p.project_name
")
print(proj_quarter)
```

## 5 · Key Fact Table Query: Slice by Category + Client + Project + Period

This is the primary analytical query fulfilling the requirement:
*"expense total and average per category per client per project per month, quarter, and year"*

### 5.1 Monthly slice

```{r keyFactMonthly, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
monthly_slice <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    d.year                                AS year,
    d.month_name                          AS month,
    c.category_name                       AS category,
    cl.client_name                        AS client,
    p.project_name                        AS project,
    COUNT(*)                              AS n_transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_expense,
    ROUND(AVG(f.amount_local), 2)         AS avg_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_date     d  ON f.date_key     = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_category c  ON f.category_key = c.category_key
  JOIN dim_client   cl ON f.client_key   = cl.client_key
  JOIN dim_project  p  ON f.project_key  = p.project_key
  -- billable filter removed: synthetic data loaded as billable=0
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_name, c.category_name, cl.client_name, p.project_name
  ORDER BY d.year, d.month, c.category_name
")
print(head(monthly_slice, 15))
```

### 5.2 Quarterly slice

```{r keyFactQuarterly, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
quarterly_slice <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    f.txn_year                            AS year,
    CONCAT('Q', f.txn_quarter)            AS quarter,
    c.category_name                       AS category,
    cl.client_name                        AS client,
    p.project_name                        AS project,
    COUNT(*)                              AS n_transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_expense,
    ROUND(AVG(f.amount_local), 2)         AS avg_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_category c  ON f.category_key = c.category_key
  JOIN dim_client   cl ON f.client_key   = cl.client_key
  JOIN dim_project  p  ON f.project_key  = p.project_key
  -- billable filter removed: synthetic data loaded as billable=0
  GROUP BY f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter, c.category_name, cl.client_name, p.project_name
  ORDER BY f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter, c.category_name
")
print(quarterly_slice)
```

```{r keyFactAnnual, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
annual_slice <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
```

## 6 · Employee Expense Summary

```{r employeeSummary, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}
emp_summary <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT
    e.full_name                           AS employee,
    f.txn_year                            AS year,
    CONCAT('Q', f.txn_quarter)            AS quarter,
    COUNT(*)                              AS n_transactions,
    ROUND(SUM(f.amount_local), 2)         AS total_expense,
    ROUND(AVG(f.amount_local), 2)         AS avg_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_employee e ON f.employee_key = e.employee_key
  GROUP BY e.full_name, f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter
  ORDER BY e.full_name, f.txn_year, f.txn_quarter
")
print(emp_summary)
```

## 7 · Bar Chart: Total Expense by Category
## 7 · Bar Chart: Total Expense by Category

```{r barChartCategory, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}

cat_plot <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
  SELECT c.category_name AS category,
         ROUND(ABS(SUM(f.amount_local)), 2) AS total_expense
  FROM fact_expenses f
  JOIN dim_category c ON f.category_key = c.category_key
  GROUP BY c.category_name
  ORDER BY total_expense DESC
")

if (nrow(cat_plot) > 0 && any(is.finite(cat_plot$total_expense))) {
  barplot(
    cat_plot$total_expense,
    names.arg = cat_plot$category,
    main = "Total Expense by Category",
    xlab = "Category",
    ylab = "Total Expense (local currency)",
    col = "steelblue",
    las = 2,
    cex.names = 0.85
  )
} else {
  cat("No data available for category chart.\n")
}
```

## 8 · Bar Chart: Total Expense by Client

```{r barChartClient, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE, author="Akshay Bannatti"}

cl_plot <- dbGetQuery(mysql_con, "
```
